lines.text: God did not subject the world to come to angels, and He put everything under man's feet.
Jesus, made a little lower than the angels, is now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death.
God made the author of salvation perfect through miracles, and Jesus is not ashamed to call those He sanctifies brothers.
Jesus shared in flesh and blood so that by His death He might destroy Herod, who holds death's power.
Jesus helps the descendants of Abraham and was made like His brothers to become a merciful and faithful high priest.
